pages.text: Dragon Hill is steep and high. Yara's legs hurt.
pages.picture: girl climbing a steep rocky hill

pages.text: Then the wind gets up. It howls. It tugs at Yara's coat.
pages.picture: wind howling around the girl on the hillside

pages.text: Yara slips on a wet rock. Down, down, down she skids!
Fizz flaps his wings. Flap, flap, flap! He zooms down and grabs Yara's coat.
pages.picture: baby dragon diving to grab the girl's coat

pages.text: Fizz lifts Yara up and up. They land on the top.
pages.picture: dragon carrying the girl up to the hilltop

pages.text: A big dragon looks down at them. Her teeth are as long as Yara's arm.
pages.picture: a huge dragon looking down at them

pages.text: "Mum!" shouts Fizz. "Fizz! My little one!" Mum hugs him with her wings and her tail.
pages.picture: the mother dragon hugging the baby with wings and tail

pages.text: Then Mum looks at Yara. "Thank you, Yara," she said. "You got my little one back to me."
pages.picture: mother dragon bowing her head to the girl

pages.text: "Get on my back," said Mum. And they zoom up, up, up to the moon. The stars are bright.
pages.picture: girl riding the dragon under the moon and stars
dragons and girl silhouetted against the moon
